lookup.后训练 · 强化学习训练流程 · AI Data Center: Post-Training · RL Training Flow · AI Data Center
lookup.选择特定行业的训练数据集，用于微调模型以适应特定领域的问答和任务。: Choose an industry dataset to fine-tune the model for domain Q&A and tasks.
lookup.过滤低质量样本：移除过短/过长文本、重复内容去重、特殊字符及有毒内容检测，确保训: Filter low-quality samples: remove too-short/long text, deduplicate, detect special/toxic content to keep training data clean and safe.
lookup.基于Self-Instruct范式，用种子指令引导LLM批量生成多样化任务指令，: Self-Instruct style: seed prompts guide the LLM to batch-generate diverse instructions (classification/generation/reasoning) for low-cost SFT data.
lookup.人工或AI对同一prompt的多个回复进行排序/二选一，构建(chosen, r: Humans or AI rank or pairwise-compare responses to build (chosen, rejected) pairs—core RLHF supervision for reward model training.
lookup.通过自动指标（长度分布、毒性分数、任务多样性）与人工抽查结合，量化数据集质量，防: Combine automatic metrics (length, toxicity, diversity) with spot checks to avoid spurious correlations (e.g. longer = better).
lookup.利用强模型（如Deepseek）自动生成指令-回复对或偏好对，结合规则过滤构建百: Use strong models (e.g. DeepSeek) to synthesize instruction-response or preference pairs with rule filtering at scale.
lookup.选择预训练大语言模型：8B适合快速实验，14B平衡性能与成本，32B提供最强性能: Pick a pretrained LLM: 8B for fast experiments, 14B balances cost/performance, 32B for peak performance.
lookup.NPU卡数量决定可用显存，当前使用64GB显存版本：8B建议8卡，14B建议16: NPU count sets available memory; with 64GB cards: 8B→8 NPUs, 14B→16, 32B→32.
lookup.verl 是一个灵活、高效且可用于生产环境的强化学习（RL）训练框架，专为大型语: verl is a flexible, efficient, production-ready RL framework for LLM post-training.
lookup.选择强化学习算法：PPO稳定高效，GPRO结合策略梯度和进化算法: Choose RL algorithm: PPO is stable; GRPO uses group-relative optimization.
lookup.近端策略优化算法 PPO（Proximal Policy Optimizatio: PPO uses four models: reward, value, reference, and policy with KL penalty to limit updates. Requires training two models—more complex to deploy.
lookup.组相对策略优化 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optim: GRPO uses three models, generates a response group per prompt, applies KL penalty vs. reference, and estimates advantage from group-relative rewards—no value model needed.
lookup.典型 RLHF lr: 1e-6 ~ 5e-6，过低导致学习缓慢, 过大导致震荡: Typical RLHF lr: 1e-6–5e-6; too low slows learning, too high oscillates.
lookup.每次训练使用的样本数量：32-128常用，大批次训练稳定，小批次更新频繁: Samples per step: 32–128 common; large batches stabilize, small batches update often.
lookup.设置完成多少个step后保存一次模型权重: Save model weights every N completed steps.
lookup.为每个 prompt 生成的 response 数量，也即 GRPO 中的 gr: Responses generated per prompt—the GRPO group size.
lookup.训练完成！模型性能已达到预期目标。: Training complete! Model performance meets expectations.
lookup.选择一个问题，查看基础模型和增强模型的回答差异: Pick a question to compare base vs. enhanced model answers.
lookup.请问车险理赔需要哪些材料？: What documents are needed for auto insurance claims?
lookup.车险理赔通常需要：保险单正本、索赔申请书、交通事故责任认定书、车辆修理发票、损失: Typically: policy, claim form, accident liability report, repair invoice, loss list, etc.
lookup.意外险包含医疗费用吗？: Does accident insurance cover medical expenses?
lookup.大部分意外险包含意外医疗费用报销，具体保额和免赔额请参照您的保险合同条款。: Most policies include accidental medical reimbursement—see your policy for limits and deductibles.
lookup.重疾险等待期是多长时间？: How long is the critical illness waiting period?
lookup.重疾险的等待期通常为90天或180天，等待期内确诊疾病一般不赔付，具体视产品而定: Usually 90 or 180 days; claims during waiting period are generally excluded—product-specific.
lookup.寿险受益人可以指定吗？: Can life insurance beneficiaries be designated?
lookup.可以。投保人或者被保险人可以指定一人或者数人为身故保险金受益人。: Yes. The policyholder or insured may designate one or more death benefit beneficiaries.
lookup.家财险保什么？: What does home property insurance cover?
lookup.家庭财产保险主要保障房屋主体、室内装修、以及室内财产（如家电、家具）因火灾、爆炸: Covers structure, interior finishes, and contents (appliances, furniture) from fire, explosion, etc.
lookup.保险犹豫期是多久？: How long is the insurance cooling-off period?
lookup.长期保险通常有10-15天的犹豫期，犹豫期内退保可全额退还保费（扣除工本费）。: Long-term policies often have 10–15 days; full premium refund minus fees if cancelled in period.
lookup.社保断缴会有影响吗？: Does a gap in social insurance payments matter?
lookup.社保断缴可能会影响医保报销待遇和养老金领取年限，建议连续缴纳。: Gaps may affect medical reimbursement and pension eligibility—continuous payment is advised.
lookup.如何查询保单状态？: How do I check policy status?
lookup.您可以通过保险公司官方APP、微信公众号或拨打客服热线查询保单状态。: Use the insurer app, WeChat official account, or customer service hotline.
lookup.百万医疗险通常有1万元免赔额，超过免赔额的部分才能报销；小额医疗险免赔额较低或无: Major medical often has ¥10k deductible; minor medical may have lower or none.
lookup.投保人豁免是什么？: What is policyholder waiver of premium?
lookup.投保人豁免是指如果投保人发生合同约定的风险（如身故、重疾），可以免交后续保费，保: If the policyholder hits covered events (death, critical illness), future premiums are waived while coverage continues.
lookup.牛顿第一定律，又称惯性定律，指一切物体在没有受到外力作用的时候，总保持匀速直线运: Newton's first law (inertia): objects stay at rest or uniform motion unless acted on by a force.
lookup.提高英语听力可以通过多听英文广播、看英文电影、跟读模仿以及进行专门的精听练习来实: Listen to broadcasts, watch films, shadow speech, and do focused listening drills.
lookup.勾股定理公式为 a² + b² = c²，其中a和b是直角三角形的两条直角边，c: a² + b² = c² where a and b are legs and c is the hypotenuse.
lookup.光合作用是制造有机物的主要途径，是生物界获取能量的根本来源，同时还维持了大气中的: It builds organic matter, powers ecosystems, and balances atmospheric CO₂/O₂.
lookup.《红楼梦》的作者是谁？: Who wrote Dream of the Red Chamber?
lookup.《红楼梦》的作者一般认为是曹雪芹，后四十回通常认为是高鹗所续。: Generally attributed to Cao Xueqin; the last 40 chapters often credited to Gao E.
lookup.微积分是研究函数的微分、积分以及有关概念和应用的数学分支，它是高等数学的基础。: Calculus studies derivatives, integrals, and applications—foundation of advanced math.
lookup.如何制定学习计划？: How to make a study plan?
lookup.制定学习计划应明确目标、分解任务、合理安排时间，并坚持执行与定期复盘。: Set goals, break tasks down, schedule time, execute consistently, and review regularly.
lookup.元素周期表是根据原子序数从小到大排序的化学元素列表，揭示了元素性质的周期性变化规: Elements ordered by atomic number showing periodic property trends.
lookup.如何培养孩子的阅读兴趣？: How to foster children's reading interest?
lookup.可以通过亲子共读、营造家庭阅读氛围、让孩子自主选择感兴趣的书籍等方式培养阅读兴趣: Shared reading, a reading-friendly home, and letting kids choose books they like.
lookup.市盈率是指股票价格除以每股收益的比率，通常用来衡量股票的投资价值及风险。: Price divided by earnings per share—a common valuation metric.
lookup.牛市和熊市有什么区别？: What's the difference between bull and bear markets?
lookup.牛市指证券市场行情普遍看涨，延续时间较长的大升市；熊市则指行情普遍看淡，延续时间: Bull: prolonged rising market; bear: prolonged declining market.
lookup.K线图又称蜡烛图，记录了股票一天的开盘价、收盘价、最高价和最低价，是技术分析的基: Candlesticks show open, close, high, low—core technical analysis tool.
lookup.如何开通股票账户？: How to open a brokerage account?
lookup.开通股票账户需要准备身份证和银行卡，通过券商的APP或营业部现场办理开户手续。: ID and bank card; apply via broker app or branch.
lookup.ETF（交易型开放式指数基金）是一种在交易所上市交易的、基金份额可变的一种开放式: Exchange-traded open-end index fund with variable shares.
lookup.止损是指当某一投资出现的亏损达到预定数额时，及时斩仓出局，以避免形成更大的亏损。: Exit when loss hits a preset threshold to limit further damage.
lookup.分红派息后，股价通常会进行除权除息处理，导致股价下调，但投资者总资产（股票+现金: Ex-dividend adjustment lowers price; total wealth (shares + cash) is theoretically unchanged.
lookup.IPO（Initial Public Offering）即首次公开募股，指企业第: Initial public offering—the first public sale of company shares.
lookup.基本面分析主要关注公司的财务状况、盈利能力、行业地位、宏观经济环境等因素。: Focus on financials, profitability, industry position, and macro context.
